quiz_map.support: The Bedrock invocation log is the record that carries the request and response bodies and the token counts.
Set the upper bound at least 1 minute in the past, so that everything in the window is already queryable.
| EventSource, EventName | The service called and the action, for example bedrock.amazonaws.com and Converse |
It leaves the data in its source format, and a fix to the parser applies to data already stored.
The person is absent unless the application adds them.
Count invocations on AwsApiCall only, or every streamed call is counted twice and a volume threshold fires at half the real rate.
| Auxiliary | Low-touch data such as verbose logs, and audit and compliance data | No |
Collection is working, so the gap is at the source.
Bedrock model invocation logging is disabled by default.
A job that sets the upper bound to the present moment silently loses any activity that is indexed a few seconds later: the next window starts after it.
Two feeds join only where they hold a key for the same entity.
When an application calls with a role, the ARN (Amazon Resource Name) reads assumed-role, then the role name, then the session name.
In the documented example its request parameters hold only the model ID, so do not look for the prompt there.
Only eventType tells them apart: AwsApiCall is the call, AwsServiceEvent is the stream completion.
An application that puts its end user there gives every model call a person key.
Lower-case both sides before comparing them.
| Workload | AppIdentity | UserIdentityArn | identity.arn | None |
Use the source address to confirm a match, not to make one.
A deletion with no ticket and no Put event after it, while model calls continue, is a true positive.
A ticketed change by the platform team, where logging resumes, is a benign true positive: the rule caught exactly what it watches for, and the activity was authorised.
Add a freshness alert before any rule depends on the feed.
| Auxiliary | Low-touch data such as verbose logs, and audit and compliance data | Not supported |

new_vendor.note: Log entry format of Amazon Bedrock model invocation logging (same for CloudWatch Logs and S3): docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-invocation-logging.html, checked 2026-11-26. requestMetadata is an optional caller-supplied object of key-value tags, so its sub-keys are caller-defined (hence the prefix). If another topic of this track proposes the same vendor under a different key, merge them.
